selection: Both complete native county/local factual table sets, not selected political outcomes.
basis: Selected government election counts, literal public candidate/answer labels and source provenance; no native PDF/HTML redistribution or document-license claim.
source_status: Both years explicitly UNOFFICIAL RESULTS. Reporting completion does not establish certification or finality.
unit_definition: 37 native municipal and grouped-ward reporting units per year, not 37 proven individual precincts.
ballot_definition: Literal Ballots Cast - Total; candidate votes remain a separate race-specific denominator.
wrapped_candidate: 2024 IND Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. / Nicole Shanahan is a native two-line label with a vertically centered count; both independent engines verify all 38 joins.
limits: Report clocks differ within each election and supply no timezone. Preserve every observation separately.
2026 minus 2024 is a reported ballot-count change, not observed partisan drop-off or measured staying home.
Matching county scope permits a descriptive county comparison, not a fixed-person cohort.
Matching municipal/ward labels do not establish unchanged boundaries or longitudinal precinct identity.
Ballot-minus-contest-vote differences are unclassified, not measured undervotes, rejected ballots or abstention.
Keep every party, independent candidate, write-in and referendum answer literal; do not pool offices.
Two-party margin changes are descriptive cross-office/same-office context, not individual persuasion.
No registration/eligible-population denominator, demographic turnout, unique-person N26 or design confidence interval is qualified.
Independent extraction checks native consistency, not independent outcome truth or latent transitions.
